description:
The Micargi Rover 7-Speed Beach Cruiser is a classic stylish bike that offers all the benefits of a safe and adventurous ride. Its multiple speeds make it easy for climbing steep hills or cruising down a flat street. The dual-spring paddy seat, extra-wide handlebars, and front and rear alloy V-brakes make your ride more comfortable.
Alloy Front and Rear V-Brakes: The V-brakes are advantages as they are lightweight, work well, and are quite inexpensive.
High-Density Foam Comfort Saddle: The wide saddle supports the rider’s back. While the extra cushioned seat ensures you can laze around on this bike seated comfortably.
Matching Color Front and Rear Fenders: The full fenders protect the rider from any mess on the ground. Their matching color adds to the bike's stylish looks.
Bend Handlebar and Black Rubber Cruiser Grips: Wide and bend handlebars help position the rider’s body in a comfortable riding posture. The rubber grips ensure your hands don’t slip away.
Perfect fit for an athletic cruiser, this Micargi 7-Speed Rover is designed particularly for who enjoy fun rides and cruising around the beach or city. The Cruiser Bike has a classic design with a tapered oversize top tube and forward pedaling geometry. The bike’s steel frame design has significantly improved its stability and makes the bike easy to control. This Beach Cruiser will surely turn heads, wherever you’re at.
